annotations.title: Polyglot JSON -> TypeScript, Zod, Pydantic v2 & JSON Schema Compiler

description: Inspects a sample JSON payload (inferring UUID, ISO-8601 datetime, email, integer vs float, and array item types) and compiles strict TypeScript interfaces, Zod schemas, Python Pydantic v2 models, and JSON Schema Draft 2020-12. Use when generating static type definitions and runtime validators in TypeScript and Python from a sample JSON response; for extracting existing function/class symbols and complexity metrics from source code, use analyze_ast_symbol_graph instead. Read-only call (32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'sample_json' (with enum defaults), uses '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats); HTTP 400 if invalid.

root_name.description: Identifier used for the generated root interface/class; defaults to 'GeneratedPayload' when omitted.

sample_json.description: JSON string or object representing the sample payload to infer types from.

strictness.description: Schema additionalProperties and format constraint mode; defaults to 'strict_formats' when omitted.

name: compile_polyglot_type_schemas

python_pydantic_v2.description: Compiled Python Pydantic v2 BaseModel class.

zod_schema.description: Compiled TypeScript Zod runtime validator schema.
